# Code Anchors: Story Evidence Report

- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/evidence.ts` — builds the per-story report from the claiming read, the selected receipt on each pull request and each story's current fingerprint
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/evidence.spec.ts` — pins named-story counting, the receipt that names no story, and changed and unknown judged receipt by receipt
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/fingerprint.ts` — takes a story's fingerprint with the record digest over its issue body in the issues repository
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/fingerprint.spec.ts` — pins that the fingerprint is the record digest and that a failed fetch names the story
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/publish-check.ts` — refuses to publish a receipt whose fingerprints are missing, extra or different from the current text
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/publish-check.spec.ts` — pins each fingerprint refusal at the publish boundary
- `libs/epic-verdicts/src/story-prs.ts` — the complete-or-failed read of each story's claiming pull requests
- `libs/pr-acceptance/src/verify.ts` — parses the receipt's story fingerprints
- `libs/portable-tools/src/nexus-cli.ts` — the evidence and story-fingerprints verbs a stage invokes
- `components/commands/nxs.analyze.md` — takes the fingerprints at the start of the run and records them in the receipt
- `components/commands/nxs.close.md` — runs the evidence report after the ledger gate and repeats its lines
- `utils/close-epic.sh` — stops before close when analyze exits on a failed story read
